title: Preamble: look-into, context, retro and triage still tell the worker to open PRs
description:
Found while building LIN-4248 (PR #2287). The dispatch preamble (`buildProxyContextPreamble`, `lib/proxy-preamble.js`) tells every worker "Being dispatched here is your mandate for the reversible work — investigate, edit, open PRs, comment", and ends "END with … PR link, commit SHA, and CI/test result". That is right for implementation, bug and review-type work, but not for the read-only stages `look-into`, `context`, `retro` and `triage`, which still get both lines.

LIN-4248 made the two Survey kinds (`survey-task`, `survey-place`) read-only through a kind gate in that function. The four stages above were left alone on purpose: changing them changes what those stages are told, which is a behaviour change on other stages.

Work: decide, per stage, whether it gets the read-only mandate (the Survey variant, `SURVEY_KINDS` in `lib/proxy-preamble.js`), and whether its closing line should ask for a PR link at all. Keep every other kind byte-identical. Add a witness test per stage, as `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-preamble.test.js` does for the Surveys.

Source: the LIN-4248 plan, Step 2 ("Not fixed here: look-into, context, retro and triage ..."), and the plan review note 1 on that ticket.

## How to go about it (from a Survey before work began)

Both Surveys (on this ticket, 11:00–11:01, at `d9c0f1cae`, after LIN-4253) found that the ticket describes code that's gone. `SURVEY_KINDS` is now a `writes` trait on each template (`lib/stage-writes.js`, `WRITES_BLOCK` in `lib/proxy-preamble.js`). They also found that the obvious move, `writes: 'one-comment'` on all four, is wrong for each:

* look-into and retro write nothing (inform-only bodies; retro says "Do not write them back");
* context posts one comment but isn't a forecast;
* triage changes labels, priority, state and project, so a read-only mandate would forbid its job.

The person's scope call, in order, each item its own piece:

1. **The vocabulary first. It is the only real decision, so write it down before code.** For each of the four, record what it actually writes, read from its template body and completion signals rather than this ticket's list. Then name each `writes` value for what the stage may write. A likely set:
   * `none`: look-into and retro, report in the session;
   * `one-comment`: context and the Surveys, with its sentences generalised away from "a forecast" and "the surveyed ticket" (this changes the Surveys' rendered text slightly; record it);
   * a tracker mode for triage: ticket fields and a comment, no code and no PRs.

   Each value gets its mandate and closing row in `WRITES_BLOCK`. Fix triage's pin reason ("Files and updates tickets"; its body forbids filing).
2. **Every entrance passes** `writes`**,** not only `dispatch-entrance`. Feedback-filed triage (`routes/workspace-api-feedback.js` `enqueueFeedbackTriage`) calls `attachProxyContext` with no `writes`, so it would keep the PR block. Resolve it there from the template; the preamble stays kind-blind. Test both triage entrances.
3. **The resume path, its own piece, with a stop rule:** `provisionResumeCredential` → `attachProxyContext` passes no `writes`, so a follow-up on a non-`work` stage gets the work mandate. Both blind reads of LIN-4253 named this. Stop and say so if it doesn't pay.
4. **The deeper copy of the same symptom, its own piece, with a stop rule:** `contextLines` (`proxy-preamble.js`) tells every worker to "update the workspace as you work (status, comments, labels)" whatever `writes` is. The Surveys' own prompts carry both that line and the read-only mandate. Gate it on `writes`.
5. **Witnesses without a new list of stages:** extend `lin-4248-survey-preamble.test.js` to loop over every `writes` value (it already finds kinds with `writesOf`). Pin the `work` block's bytes, so every other kind is shown byte-identical. Flip the "converse is false today" test, and keep the pin table's reason per kind.

**Not in this ticket:** deriving each template's workflow formatter (`formatInformOnlyWorkflow` / `formatReadOnlyWorkflow`, retro's closing paragraph) from `writes`, so the body and the preamble can't disagree (a rendered change across all templates; to the tally); folding the other per-kind tables.

## At merge (who else must learn about it)

* Every `work` stage's dispatched text is byte-identical.
* All three entrances (dispatch, feedback triage, resume, unless stopped) pass `writes`.
* No test holds a list of stage names.
* `lib/stage-writes.js`'s doc, the traits paragraph in `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md`, and a row in `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md` (this one is a rendered change).
* `STAGE_INTENT`'s `READING` relation is stated again for the new values.

## Implementation Plan

Implemented as approved in [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2292](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2292>) (squash-merged as `2f0c9d5b`): look-into and retro declare `writes: none`, context `one-comment`, triage `ticket-fields`; every entrance (launch, follow-up/resume, feedback triage and autopilot) passes `stageWrites(kind)`; the "update the workspace as you work" clause is gated to `work`; the `work` block is byte-identical (fixture `tests/fixtures/lin-4251-work-blocks.json`). Deviations from the plan: none. Close-out added a witness for the declared-record resume path and fixed two misplaced doc blocks (commit `9ff1d0dc`). Left out on purpose: plan-review/review/retrospective-audit (LIN-4258) and deriving body wording from `writes` (LIN-4259).

This fits one session. The full plan (vocabulary decision, entrance table, drift notes, witnesses, risks) is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

comments.body: Priority set to Medium (priorityLevel 2): the four read-only stages (look-into, context, retro, triage) are told they may open PRs and end with a PR link, so a run can open a PR it should not; it recurs on every dispatch of those kinds, but nothing is lost or corrupted by it today, and the Surveys (LIN-4248, merged as 29f14bf6) already show the fix shape. Labels: kind:follow-up, front:prompt-engine. Related: LIN-4248.

Label note: the workspace API has no label write on an existing issue (PATCH drops labelIds), so the type label could not be applied. Intended: kind:follow-up and front:prompt-engine, both in the workspace catalog. Someone with label access should add them.

## Note from LIN-4253 (merged: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2290, `d9c0f1ca`)

Two things in this ticket's wording are now stale or need to be known before starting:

1. **`SURVEY_KINDS` is gone.** A stage's write mode is now the `writes` property on its template (`work` | `one-comment`), defined in `lib/stage-writes.js`. The "Work" paragraph above ("decide, per stage, whether it gets the read-only mandate (the Survey variant, `SURVEY_KINDS` in `lib/proxy-preamble.js`)") should read: set `writes` on the `look-into`, `context`, `retro` and `triage` templates in `lib/prompt-template-defs.js`. All four are `work` today, deliberately, so nothing changed in what they are told. `triage` needs a third state (it writes ticket updates), which is why the trait is `writes` and not a boolean `readOnly`. Whether `route` is offered for each is likewise the template's `route` (`null` = hand-only).
2. **Follow-ups/resumes ignore `writes`.** `provisionResumeCredential` in `lib/proxy-preamble.js` (both `attachProxyContext` calls) passes no `writes`, so a follow-up (`followUpTo`) to any one-comment stage gets the default work block ("open PRs" mandate, PR-link closing). This predates LIN-4253 and was kept as-is because that ticket had to be byte-identical. It is a LIN-4251-class change: threading `writes` into the resume attach changes output, so do it here and add a witness for it.

A golden-style characterisation test of every kind's dispatched prompt was used for LIN-4253 and then removed; if you change prompt text, `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md` needs a row (see `docs/architecture/prompt-system.md`).

## Survey open-0: LIN-4251 @ d9c0f1cae

**The ticket describes a mechanism that no longer exists.** At this base, LIN-4253 (#2290) replaced the `SURVEY_KINDS` kind gate with a `writes` trait declared on each template (`lib/stage-writes.js`, `WRITES_BLOCK` in `lib/proxy-preamble.js:190`). The work isn't "add four kinds to a set" now. It's "set `writes` on four templates", and the vocabulary has only `work` and `one-comment`. `lib/stage-writes.js:12-16` already anticipates this ticket: "LIN-4251's triage writes ticket updates".

**Why it's harder than it looks: `one-comment` doesn't fit any of the four.** Its mandate and closing are Survey wording: "a read-only forecast… your only write is the one comment on the surveyed ticket", then "END with the link to the one comment you posted". Each stage's own body asks for something else:

- **look-into** and **retro** use `formatInformOnlyWorkflow`, which says "Present your findings to the user". Retro adds "Do not write them back to Linear… unless asked". These stages write nothing, so a "link to the comment you posted" closing would contradict the body.
- **context** uses `formatReadOnlyWorkflow`, which says "Add findings as a comment". This is the closest to `one-comment`, but it isn't a forecast and has no "surveyed ticket".
- **triage** is not read-only. It changes labels, priority, state and project, posts a comment, and has the completion signal "Changes applied in Linear". Giving it the read-only mandate would forbid its job.

So the "decide per stage" step is really "add one or two `WRITES` values with their own mandate and closing". Something like `none` (report in session) and `ticket-metadata` (triage), and possibly a neutral comment-only variant for context. Each one needs a row in `WRITES_BLOCK` and a row in the `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js` census. The witness tests should then assert against those new rows, not copy the Survey test.

**A second triage entrance the template change won't reach.** `routes/workspace-api-feedback.js:236-268` (`enqueueFeedbackTriage`) builds a triage prompt and calls `attachProxyContext(feedbackProxyContext(...))` without a `writes` value. Only `dispatch-entrance.js:1084` reads `PROMPT_TEMPLATES[kind].writes`. So feedback-filed triage would keep the old "open PRs" block even after the template changes. Either pass `writes` through there, or move the lookup down into `attachProxyContext` keyed by kind.

**A leftover contradiction, Surveys included.** `contextLines` (`proxy-preamble.js:327-360`) still tells every worker to "update the workspace as you work (status, comments, labels)" whatever `writes` is. This Survey's own prompt has both that line and the read-only mandate. Every new read-only mode will inherit the conflict unless that line is gated on `writes` too. The task doesn't mention this, and it's the deeper version of the same symptom.

**"Keep every other kind byte-identical"** is easy to check, since the default stays `work`. It needs a snapshot of the `work` block, though, not just per-stage tests.

**What I'd do first:** for each of the four stages, write down what it actually writes, reading the template body and completion signals rather than the ticket's list. That gives the set of new `WRITES` values and their wording, and the wording is the only real decision here. Then fix the feedback-triage plumbing and gate the "update the workspace" line, then the witness tests. Retro has `route: null` and triage has two entrances, so test both triage paths.

## Survey global: LIN-4251 @ d9c0f1cae

**The ticket describes an older version of the code.** `SURVEY_KINDS` no longer exists: LIN-4253 (#2290, this base) replaced it with a `writes` trait on each template (`lib/stage-writes.js`: `work` | `one-comment`). `dispatch-entrance.js:1084` reads `writes` from the template, and `proxy-preamble.js` uses it as the key into `WRITES_BLOCK`. The preamble holds no stage names, and `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js:155` checks that. This part of the code improved this week: one home per trait, and a pin table with a reason per kind. It already expects this ticket: `stage-writes.js`, `prompt-system.md` and three pin reasons say "until LIN-4251".

**The obvious move, `writes: one-comment` on all four, is wrong for each of them.** That mandate says "read-only forecast … your only write is the one comment on the surveyed ticket":
- `look-into` and `retro` are inform-only (`formatInformOnlyWorkflow`; retro: "Do not write them back to Linear"). They write **nothing**, so asking for a comment link would ask for a write.
- `context` posts one comment (`formatReadOnlyWorkflow`), but it is not a "forecast" or a "surveyed ticket".
- `triage` changes labels, priority, state and project. It is not a READING stage in `STAGE_INTENT`, so any non-`work` value on it fails `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js:114` and contradicts the doc in `stage-writes.js`.

So the first decision is the vocabulary, not one decision per stage: probably `none` (look-into, retro), a one-comment wording that fits any stage (context, Surveys), and either a mode for triage's metadata writes or triage left on `work` with the reason recorded.

**Who must learn about a new value:** `WRITES` (`WRITES_VALUES` derives from it) and a `WRITES_BLOCK` row (`resolveWrites` throws without one, so a missing row fails loudly). Also the pin table's rows and reasons, the "converse is false today" test (`:120`, which must flip), the doc in `stage-writes.js`, the traits paragraph in `prompt-system.md`, and a row in `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md`, because this is a rendered change, unlike LIN-4253. The declaration edits barely move the budgeted defs (`prompt-size-budget.test.js:72`).

**Second copy to avoid:** "a witness test per stage" written as a new list of stages. `lin-4248-survey-preamble.test.js` already finds its kinds with `writesOf(kind)`. Extend it to loop over every value instead. It also pins the `work` sentences literally, so "keep every other kind byte-identical" is already guarded.

**Better, at a cost this task can carry:** name each value for what the stage may write, generalise the one-comment sentences away from "survey", and fix triage's pin reason "Files and updates tickets", because the triage body forbids filing.

**Better still, not this task's to carry:** template bodies state their write policy a second time (`formatInformOnlyWorkflow` / `formatReadOnlyWorkflow`, retro's last paragraph), alongside `writes`. Deriving the workflow formatter from `writes` would stop the body and the preamble from disagreeing. That is a rendered change across all templates.

### Plan Review Verdict

**Verdict:** Approve. The premise holds at `d9c0f1ca` (still main), every entrance it names is real and complete, and the `work` byte-pin comes first. The notes below are for the builder and don't change the plan's shape.

**What I checked, against source at main**
- **Premise.** `SURVEY_KINDS` is gone. `WRITES_BLOCK` (`lib/proxy-preamble.js:190`) has only `work` and `one-comment`, and the `one-comment` text is specific to the Surveys ("read-only forecast", "surveyed ticket"). The four template bodies say what Decision 1's table says: look-into and retro use `formatInformOnlyWorkflow`, and retro adds "unless asked" (`prompt-template-defs.js:1179`); context uses `formatReadOnlyWorkflow`; triage applies label, priority, state and project changes. The vocabulary fits each one.
- **Entrances.**
  - I grepped every `attachProxyContext(` and `provisionResumeCredential(` call. Only three places carry an attach: the dispatch-entrance launch arm (`:1072`, already passes `writes`), the follow-up arm (`:1045`, `attach` has no `writes`), and the two feedback twins (`workspace-api-feedback.js:266/329`).
  - Inside `provisionResumeCredential`, both `attachProxyContext` calls (`:833` record-less, `:859` declared) forward no `writes`. The plan names both.
  - `follow-up-dispatch.js:246`, `chat-tools.js:1889`, `wake-credential.js:106` and `routes/dispatch.js:1487` pass no `attach`, as the plan says. `collective.js:373` is `kind: 'custom'`.
  - The factory calls `finalizePrompt(routing.harness, effectiveKind)` (`dispatch-factory.js:1110`), so resolving feedback triage through the second argument works.
- **Gating `contextLines`.** There are exactly eight variants (`proxy-preamble.js:320-360`), and all of them end with the "update the workspace" clause. Capturing literals before editing (step 1) is the right guard. Today `proxy-preamble.test.js` and `lin-4248-survey-preamble.test.js` pin only sentences and "equals no-writes".
- **Safeguards.** The resume change only forwards a value into a function that already validates it before minting (`resolveWrites` runs first in `attachProxyContext`). It doesn't change grant, owner or record handling. The unknown-value throw-before-mint test stays.
- **History.** The touched files have changed only in LIN-4248 (`29f14bf6`) and LIN-4253 (`d9c0f1ca`) since the ticket was written. The plan already reads from after both.

**Notes for the builder (none blocking)**
1. **The forward READING test changes too, not only the "converse" one.** `lin-4253-stage-traits.test.js:114` asserts that every stage with `writes !== 'work'` is READING. Once triage is `ticket-fields` this fails, because triage's STAGE_INTENT is "This is filing", not READING. Write the relation as `writes ∈ {none, one-comment} ⇔ STAGE_INTENT READING` and replace both tests (`:114` and `:120`) with that one two-way statement. Do the same in the `stage-writes.js` doc, whose sentence "Every `writes !== 'work'` stage is READING" becomes false.
2. **plan-review has the same defect and stays out of scope. Record that, and don't make the new relation forbid fixing it.** plan-review's body says "You are read-only: post the verdict … do not edit the plan, build it or file tickets" (`prompt-template-defs.js:795`). It writes exactly one comment, but it still gets "open PRs" and the PR-link closing. This dispatch received both. It is JUDGE, not READING, so the two-way relation in note 1 would make `plan-review: one-comment` a test failure later. That's fine as long as the PR says this is today's fact and not a rule, and names plan-review as the known case left over. review and retrospective-audit also use `formatReadOnlyWorkflow`, but they don't fit any value cleanly: review records a ledger, and the audit files follow-ups. They go in the same note. The person scoped this ticket to four stages and the original text accepts "review-type work" on `work`, so keep it at four and send plan-review to the tally or a follow-up.
3. **Budget: two ceilings move, not one.** The new lookup export lands in `lib/prompt-templates.js`, which is budgeted separately (`prompt-size-budget.test.js:73`, 19359) in addition to the defs (`:72`), and `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES` (`:164`) is their exact sum. Record the reason beside all three.
4. **One more doc.** `docs/architecture/source-map.md:168` lists the `writes` values ("`work`, the default; `one-comment`, the Surveys' read-only forecast"). Add it to the doc list next to `stage-writes.js`, `prompt-system.md` and the change-log row.
5. **The census of `attachProxyContext(` call sites** must skip the definition (`proxy-preamble.js:692`) and list the two calls inside `provisionResumeCredential` with the reason "forwards `attach.writes`". Otherwise it counts five lib sites where the plan's table shows three.
6. **Triage's closing should cover a change it could not apply.** The 09:13 comment on this ticket records that the workspace API's PATCH drops `labelIds`. A `ticket-fields` closing that asks only for "each field change, before → after" pushes a worker to report a label change that didn't land. Ask it to name intended changes it couldn't apply as well. It's one clause in the closing row, and the per-value phrase witness can check it.
7. **Leave the Surveys' body and signals as they are.** `lib/completion-signals.js:222-244` and the Survey bodies still say "surveyed ticket". That's correct for Surveys and outside the preamble, so only the `one-comment` preamble rows get generalised, as the plan says. The witness "`one-comment` has no 'forecast' or 'surveyed'" must assert on the preamble block, not the whole rendered prompt.

## Review — LIN-4251

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2292 at head `5490164c` (one commit on merge base `d234b94a`). It is mergeable into main `b5cc4c62`. Main has moved on by LIN-4247, which touches none of this PR's files.

CI: green on head `5490164c`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success. I also ran the 8 touched test files at head myself: 360 pass, 0 fail.

**Scope matches the plan.** All 17 changed files are in the plan's places, plus the plan-review notes' extras: `source-map.md`, both budget ceilings and `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES`, and the census skipping the definition. Nothing overran.

**What I checked**
- **Vocabulary.** look-into and retro are `none`, context is `one-comment`, and triage is `ticket-fields`. Each mandate fits its stage's own body:
  - retro's "unless asked" becomes "post nothing to Linear unless the person asks";
  - context's "add findings as a comment" fits the one-comment mandate;
  - triage's mandate names labels, priority, state and project.

  The triage closing covers changes that could not be applied (plan-review note 6). The `one-comment` wording is generalised in the preamble only, and the Survey bodies and signals are left alone (note 7). No boolean `readOnly` was added.
- **`work` is byte-identical.** I ran main's own `buildProxyContextPreamble` against `tests/fixtures/lin-4251-work-blocks.json` and all 36 keys matched. That covers the eight hint variants × prose/mcp, with an issue and without, plus the no-provider cases. So the fixture really is the pre-change block, not one captured after the change.
- **Entrances.** All of these pass `stageWrites(kind)`:
  - the launch arm;
  - the follow-up arm, through `attach.writes` into both `provisionResumeCredential` calls;
  - feedback triage;
  - feedback autopilot.

  The factory passes `effectiveKind` as `finalizePrompt`'s second argument (`dispatch-factory.js:1110`), and feedback triage's kind is `'triage'`. The preamble still imports no registry, and the existing lin-4253 guard is green. The unknown-`writes` throw still runs before any mint.
- **Census and READING relation.** The census covers 6 call sites in 4 files. The READING relation is now two-way, `READING ⇔ writes ∈ {none, one-comment}`, and replaces both old tests.
- **Regression check.** Since the ticket was created, these files have changed only in LIN-4248 (`29f14bf6`) and LIN-4253 (`d9c0f1ca`). Both pinned text that this PR changes on purpose. No revert was re-applied.
- **Siblings.**
  - plan-review, review and retrospective-audit still declare `work`. This is the known leftover from plan-review note 2, and it is outside this ticket's four-stage scope.
  - `lib/prompts/autopilot-kickoff.js:446` carries its own "open PRs" mandate. That is correct, because autopilot is work.
  - No other entrance builds the preamble. `buildProxyContextPreamble` has one caller.

**Mutation checks.** I ran each against the 6 touched suites and reverted every one. The tree was left clean and the worktree removed.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: feedback triage drops `writes` | 1 red (feedback-route) |
| M2: follow-up `attach` drops `writes` | 6 red |
| M3: resume, no-record path, drops `writes` | 6 red |
| **M4: resume, declared-record path, drops `writes`** | **0 red: the line has no witness** |
| M5: `contextLines` gate removed | 39 red |
| M6: launch arm drops `writes` | 18 red |
| M7: triage back to `work` | 5 red |

**Findings for close-out to fix (none changes the design)**
1. **Witness the declared-record resume path (M4).** The follow-up witnesses in `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-dispatch-paths.test.js` stub `getGrantDeclaration` as `{ state: 'none' }`, so only the no-record branch is driven.
   - **Where:** `tests/unit/lin-3134-resume-helper.test.js`, which already builds `{ state: 'record', record }` fixtures.
   - **What:** add a test that calls `provisionResumeCredential` with a valid declared record and `attach: { issueIdentifier, prompt, writes: 'none' }`. Assert that the returned prompt contains `Just END with your findings` and does not match `/open PRs|PR link|commit SHA/`.
   - **Check:** re-run M4 (remove `writes: attach.writes ?? null` after `declaredSite: record.site`) and confirm the new test goes red.
2. **A JSDoc block is detached.** In `lib/proxy-preamble.js`, `readOnlyContextLines` and its JSDoc (lines ~321–350) were inserted between `buildProxyContextPreamble`'s JSDoc (ending `@returns {string} Block to append to the prompt`, line 319) and the function itself (line 353). The public function has lost its doc.
   - **Fix:** move `readOnlyContextLines` and its comment above `buildProxyContextPreamble`'s JSDoc block, starting `/**\n * Build the proxy-context …`, with no text change.
3. **A comment heads the wrong export.** In `lib/prompt-templates.js:195-201`, `stageWrites` was inserted between the `DISPATCH_DEFAULT_KINDS` comment ("The ONE source of truth the dispatch-defaults readers agree on…") and `export const DISPATCH_DEFAULT_KINDS`. That comment now heads `stageWrites`.
   - **Fix:** move the `stageWrites` doc line and function to just after `export const DISPATCH_DEFAULT_KINDS = …`. The bytes are the same, so the budget does not move.

**Accepted as is.** `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-stages.test.js` now lists `['survey-task', 'survey-place']` literally. That file tests the Survey stages themselves, and `one-comment` no longer singles them out. This is not a per-stage witness list of the kind the ticket forbids. The witnesses for the four stages loop over `WRITES_VALUES` and template-derived kinds.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (bounded class: Decision 2, the resume entrance). The declared-record follow-up forwards `writes`. No test drives it (M4 survived). **Before the merge:** close-out adds the witness in finding 1. The distinguishing precondition is `getGrantDeclaration` returning `{ state: 'record' }` with `attach.writes = 'none'`. Right: the `none` closing and no PR wording. Wrong: the work block.
- **Inside** (the ticket's own symptom: the dispatched text a live worker receives). Once deployed, a hand-dispatched `look-into` and a hand-dispatched `triage` receive the new block, not the PR mandate. Tests prove the rendered text, but no test reads a real queued item. **After the deploy:** dispatch one of each and `GET /api/proxy/dispatch/<id>/prompt`. Look-into must contain `Being dispatched here is a reading pass`, triage must contain `Being dispatched here is to triage the ticket`, and neither may contain `open PRs`. **Rollback:** revert the PR's squash commit. It is reversible, because nothing is persisted in a new shape.
- **Outside** (a different problem: other stages' write modes). plan-review (one comment, JUDGE), review and retrospective-audit still get the `work` mandate.
